About us

Helping you bring every detail together

Plan Your Event is a discovery and enquiry service for people planning weddings, parties and private celebrations in Australia. We are not a planning company. We help you find the planner who is.

Get event planning quotes

Why we built this

Great events do not simply happen. Behind every celebration people remember are hundreds of decisions, most of which have to be made in an order nobody explains, and all of which land on one person. Usually that person also has a job.

Plan Your Event was created from more than 15 years of experience across events, styling, customer service and working alongside event professionals and suppliers. That experience covers both sides of the same problem: the excitement of building something people will remember, and the pressure of being the one who has to hold it together.

What became obvious over those years is that the hard part is rarely the taste. It is the coordination. People know roughly what they want. What they do not have is a supplier list they trust, a realistic timeline, and someone who will answer the phone on the day so they do not have to.

What we actually do

We connect people planning an event with professional event planners, wedding planners, party planners and event coordinators around Australia. You tell us the occasion, the area, the rough date and how much help you want. We pass that enquiry to planners who cover your area and work on your kind of event, and they contact you directly.

We do not plan your event, quote on it, or take a share of your planning fee. You engage and pay your planner directly. Our job finishes when you have people worth talking to.

How we think about planning help

Most people arrive assuming they either hire a planner for everything or do it all themselves. In practice Australian planners package their work at three levels, and picking the right level is the difference between a quote that feels reasonable and one that feels absurd. Full planning hands over the whole build. Partial planning picks up what has stalled. On-the-day coordination leaves your plan alone and simply runs it. Our planning services page compares all three side by side.

The events we cover

Weddings, proposals, engagement parties, milestone birthdays, baby showers, christenings, anniversaries, private celebrations and corporate events. Some of those have deep planner coverage in every capital city. Others are more specialised, and the enquiry goes to a smaller group. Either way, the enquiry goes to planners who have run that kind of event, rather than everyone on a list.

On the 15 years

Plan Your Event was created from more than 15 years of experience across events, styling, customer service and working with event suppliers. Plan Your Event itself is a new service. The experience informed it, it is not a trading history.

Who we are not

We are not an event planning company, an event hire supplier, a florist, a cake maker or a photography service. Plan Your Event is a specialist planner discovery brand and nothing else.

How enquiries are handled

Plan Your Event works with My Event Match to process enquiries and route them to relevant planners. That relationship is disclosed on the enquiry form before you submit anything.

Our part of the picture

Where Plan Your Event fits

Plan Your Event covers planning and coordination. It does not cover the suppliers a planner books on your behalf, and it does not try to.

Plan Your Event covers

Event planners, wedding planners, party planners, event coordinators, wedding coordinators, planning packages, coordination packages and venue sourcing.

Find a planner

Your planner covers

Once engaged, your planner deals with the florists, caterers, stylists, hire companies, cake makers, photographers and entertainers your event needs. That is their supplier network, and it is a large part of what you are paying for.

You always keep

The decisions. A planner turns your brief into something that happens on time and inside budget. If a planner is replacing your taste rather than executing it, keep talking to the others.

One enquiry, then it is somebody else's job

Ready to hand some of it over?

Tell us what you are planning. We will pass it to planners who work on your kind of event.
